examples/examples.candidate: Example sources the module from the parent directory
Empty chart_version installs the latest chart
Credential variables have descriptions and string types

terraform-helm-carbon-intensity-exporter.candidate: Chart dependencies are updated before install (dependency_update = true)
Values are YAML-encoded into a single values document
Chart repository is the local .upstream/charts path rather than a remote repository
Values merge is shallow (nested maps are not deep-merged)
The exporter is installed as a Helm release under the name the operator chose
Reinstalling under a name already in use replaces the existing release
The exporter's namespace is created when it does not exist yet
A given chart version is pinned and an empty version means the latest chart
Values the operator supplies reach the exporter chart
A namespace given in the operator's values overrides the one passed to the chart
TFLint runs the terraform plugin with the 'all' preset
Lint requires a declared Terraform version and declared required providers
Lint requires every variable and output to have a description
Lint requires every variable to declare a type
Lint enforces snake_case naming for declarations
Lint flags unused declarations
Lint requires module sources to be pinned
Release name/namespace/chart_version/values are declared as typed inputs with descriptions
values accepts any type (no schema validation)
Version-constraint comment in versions.tf restating the supported tools
